mapper.select: SELECT ce.*, c.coursename, CASE WHEN ce.anonymous = 1 THEN '匿名' ELSE s.studentname END as studentname, t.teachername FROM course_evaluation ce LEFT JOIN course c ON ce.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN student s ON ce.studentid = s.studentid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE ce.courseid = #{courseid} ORDER BY ce.createtime DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_evaluation WHERE courseid = #{courseid}

SELECT ce.*, c.coursename, s.studentname, t.teachername FROM course_evaluation ce LEFT JOIN course c ON ce.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN student s ON ce.studentid = s.studentid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE ce.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM course_evaluation WHERE studentid = #{studentid} AND courseid = #{courseid}

SELECT ce.*, c.coursename, t.teachername FROM course_evaluation ce LEFT JOIN course c ON ce.courseid = c.courseid LEFT JOIN teacher t ON c.teacherid = t.teacherid WHERE ce.studentid = #{studentid} ORDER BY ce.createtime DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_evaluation (courseid, studentid, teachingscore, contentscore, difficultyscore, overallscore, comment, anonymous, createtime) VALUES (#{courseid}, #{studentid}, #{teachingscore}, #{contentscore}, #{difficultyscore}, #{overallscore}, #{comment}, #{anonymous}, #{createtime})
mapper.select: SELECT AVG(teachingscore) as avgTeaching, AVG(contentscore) as avgContent, AVG(difficultyscore) as avgDifficulty, AVG(overallscore) as avgOverall, COUNT(*) as totalCount FROM course_evaluation WHERE courseid = #{courseid}
